title: Impure
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.149 Numbered Discourses 3.149
  • 15. Maṅgalavagga 15. Good Fortune

Asucisutta Impure

“Tīhi, bhikkhave …pe… “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. … asucinā kāyakammena, asucinā vacīkammena, asucinā manokammena—Impure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. … imehi kho …pe… evaṁ niraye.

Tīhi, bhikkhave …pe… Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. … sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena—Pure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”

Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.

Catutthaṁ.
